title: cardamine caledonica
intro: Cardamine caledonica, commonly known as Wood Sorrel or French Sorrel, is a perennial plant species in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is known for its edible leaves, which have been used for centuries in various cuisines, particularly in salads and as a garnish. The leaves and stems of Cardamine caledonica have been traditionally used in herbal medicine, and are said to have health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as a natural antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and other phytochemicals that are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
